Built **ASHEN WING**, a playable dark-fantasy cave flight game.

- **Controls:** Space/up arrow or tap to flap; X or the Cast button to fire.
- **Gameplay:** Navigate cave gaps, collect souls, and fight three original bosses. You have three hearts; defeat all three bosses to win.
- **Mobile:** Responsive phone and tablet layout with touch controls.
- **Also included:** Sound toggle, animated cave scenery, boss health bars, and a retry screen.

Verified the game runs in Chromium and captured desktop gameplay. Assumed a side-scrolling arcade interpretation of the brief; the game uses custom 2D canvas artwork rather than a 3D engine.
